patch.value: Bring pm-graph to real 100% line/branch/function coverage and raise the gate to 100

The coverage gate currently sits at lines 81 / branches 77 / functions 88. Drive every uncovered line and branch through real behavioural tests (harness commands, exported functions, local Neo4j error paths), remove genuinely dead code, and raise coverageGate.thresholds to 100/100/100.
Every source file reports 100.00 line/branch/function coverage; coverageGate.thresholds in package.json set to 100/100/100; npm run release:check exits 0; no gate weakened

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Baseline coverage: lines 85.49% / branches 80.17% / functions 90.43%. Source file src/index.ts: lines 84.22% / branches 78.54% / functions 89.66%. Scripts already at 100%. Uncovered lines concentrated in: Neo4j internal functions (toPlain/toNumber/neo4jFriendlyError/loadNeo4j), command help texts and error paths in activate(), graph analysis branches, and utility function edge cases.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Coverage milestone: added behavioral tests in test/coverage-gaps.test.ts and test/neo4j-install-fallback.test.ts with real SDK harness workspaces and a loader-routed Neo4j driver surface. The first full run passes 287/287 tests and reports src/index.ts at L98.61% / B89.12% / F98.86%; scripts remain 100%. Export widenings parseNeo4jMs and workspaceFromPmRoot are justified because their return branches are not observably distinguishable through the command surface (invalid timeout parsing only changes driver config; custom-root workspace derivation requires direct path cases), and both retain production behavior. toPlain/toNumber/neo4jFriendlyError were covered through the actual query/status/neighbors/sync handlers with a loader-routed driver and were not widened.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Second coverage milestone: exercised tracker-root discovery (typed and generic errors), unreadable tracker SDK failures, unexpected export/sync/impact error wrapping via real registered handlers, malformed/externally-targeted dependency records, case-insensitive ambiguity and capped id suggestions, and direct Neo4j-friendly default URI/error branches. Targeted tests pass; source exports now include only the documented helpers needed for otherwise unreachable direct branch assertions (parseNeo4jMs, workspaceFromPmRoot, neo4jFriendlyError, resolveItemIdOrThrow, runPmGraph).

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Dead-code removal: removed the explain-command null-report branch (src/index.ts) because resolveItemIdOrThrow selects from itemNodeIds(graph), while explainItem's only null path is itemNodeMap(graph) using the identical PmItem label predicate on the same graph snapshot. The invariant is enforced by itemNodeIds/itemNodeMap themselves; the public explainItem helper remains nullable for unresolved direct callers.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Third coverage milestone: added behavioral coverage for legacy dependency key normalization, malformed/duplicate relationships, external nodes and facet edges, sparse legacy metadata fallbacks, parser edge cases, non-string filter properties, capped suggestions, and JSON/Mermaid renderer fallbacks. The small pure helpers are exported with existing API documentation solely so these malformed-input branches can be exercised without SDK/API doubles.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Fourth coverage milestone: exercised offline analytics on dangling/duplicate/cyclic/componented graphs, longest-chain ties, topo cycles, connector calculations, sparse item titles/status/depths, and all registered handlers with omitted optional args. Removed three unreachable explain helper fallbacks: structural edges are already restricted to the item map, and dependencyDepths initializes every resolved item.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Fifth coverage milestone: exercised workspace-root fallback precedence, explicit PM_GRAPH_PROJECT_KEY, PlantUML/JSON malformed-property renderers, default relationship types, direct engine failure wrapping, and all three process/workspace context fallbacks. The sparse graph fixture now starts from a genuinely legacy minimal item shape.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Sixth coverage milestone: added real loader-backed Neo4j module-shape tests for named exports, default exports, successful post-install retry, non-Error import rejection formatting, and signaled npm install status. These use the actual registered command harness and deterministic loader fixtures; no SDK/API doubles or Bolt server are involved.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Seventh coverage milestone: removed unreachable Map fallback branches from analyzeGraph. structuralEdges is item-only, degree maps are initialized for every item, undirected adjacency is initialized for every queued item, and dependencyDepths initializes every item; explicit type-preserving invariant assertions replace redundant runtime defaults without changing behavior.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Eighth coverage milestone: moved the canonical impact-envelope invariant into the documented requireImpactResult helper and covered both real SDK envelopes (impact and analyze drift) through runPmGraph. This preserves the generic-failure contract without requiring an SDK/API double and closes the previously unreachable impact-handler lines.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Ninth coverage milestone: directly exercised parseAnalyticsFlags's host-handled --help arm, which cannot be reached after command handlers short-circuit through hasHelpFlag. The parser remains defensive for direct SDK callers.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Tenth coverage/contract correction: restored the explicit parseNeo4jMs negative-value guard and now exercises absent, blank, malformed, negative, decimal, non-finite, and valid timeout values through the real sync command's Neo4j driver configuration. Restored private visibility for neo4jFriendlyError, parseNeo4jMs, runPmGraph, and workspaceFromPmRoot; their behavior is covered through command handlers and the SDK graph engine. Kept graphFromItems exported only because malformed legacy dependency/metadata records cannot be produced by the SDK's ItemMetadata contract but are covered by direct graph construction, and kept renderMermaid/renderJsonGraph exported only for malformed GraphNode property branches that the real exporter/analysis surfaces otherwise exercise with typed string metadata. Added real query assertions proving toPlain preserves functions and symbols. requireImpactResult remains exported because a non-impact SDK envelope is a real contract-drift failure and is tested with a real SDK analyze envelope.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Eleventh correction: fixed the private runPmGraph JSDoc placement after narrowing exports; current build and docstring gate pass. The real-command timeout test and Neo4j query conversion test pass, including function and symbol preservation through toPlain.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Twelfth coverage correction: the registered impact command now supplies a valid tracker for graph shaping and a missing tracker on the subsequent canonical SDK call, producing the real  CommandError wrapper and covering its catch path without exporting the internal runner.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Correction to the previous comment: the registered impact command supplies a valid tracker for graph shaping and a missing tracker on the subsequent canonical SDK call, producing the real runPmGraph CommandError wrapper and covering its catch path without exporting the internal runner.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Thirteenth coverage milestone: added a two-neighbor explain fixture so the real neighbor sorting comparator executes, closing the only uncovered source function reported by the full 298-test coverage run.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Fourteenth coverage milestone: removed redundant nullish branches where SDK contracts make values total (root derivation, canonical graph ids, DFS adjacency), added real rotated-cycle and converging-path fixtures, covered no-suggestion id errors, canonical impact limits, end-only relationships, omitted exporter context, and exercised the connection-error default URI through the real fake-driver-backed sync command.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Fifteenth coverage milestone: removed the unreachable cycle-rotation branch guaranteed away by the DFS start-order invariant, removed SDK-required cost/options fallbacks, and added real command coverage for bare --edges, both-direction impact, omitted exporter context, and converging/rotated offline graph paths.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Sixteenth coverage milestone: normalized optional summary impact envelopes through the contract-checked requireImpactResult helper, so real SDK summary responses safely become empty affected rows and no longer need defensive row/path array branches in the command. Added real summary/full SDK envelope tests and a converging shortest-path fixture.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Seventeenth correction: restored the requireImpactResult JSDoc attachment after adding its complete-impact type aliases; npm build and the docstring gate now pass.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Eighteenth coverage milestone: switched the named Neo4j loader fixture to a true ESM named-only module, and added real query/sync/status/neighbors cleanup-failure runs so all command finally paths execute, including session-close rejection. These tests remain loader-backed SDK harness tests, not API doubles.
